items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok 4.6: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents at Same Price as 4.5
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok 4.6：同價大幅升級長程代理與互動能力
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Grok 4.6 on August 12, describing it as a significant improvement over Grok 4.5 focused on long-running agents, interactive and visual work, and complex multi-step tasks. It matches GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index while retaining the $2/M input and $6/M output pricing. The model is available immediately in the API, Cursor, Grok Build and Grok Bot, with 2× usage included for the first week.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 於 8 月 12 日正式發布 Grok 4.6，強調長程代理、程式碼庫操作與視覺互動任務的顯著進步，定價維持每百萬 tokens $2 輸入 / $6 輸出。模型在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上與 GPT-5.6 Sol 持平。即日起於 API、Cursor、Grok Build 與 Grok Bot 可用，首週加倍用量。
items_flat.analysis_en: This keeps xAI competitive on the price-performance frontier while targeting the agentic workloads that drive real productivity. Independent long-horizon evaluations versus closed rivals remain the key uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這凸顯 xAI 以快速迭代與高性價比搶市的策略；代理能力的實用提升可能吸引更多開發者，但與閉源旗艦在特定領域的差距與長期安全表現仍待市場驗證。
items_flat.quote: Introducing Grok 4.6. It delivers frontier intelligence and is a significant improvement over Grok 4.5 at the same price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 推出 Grok 4.6。它提供前沿智慧，並在相同價格下較 Grok 4.5 有顯著改進。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind Launches SL2T: Sign-Language-to-Text Model Powers ASL Input on Pixel 11
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 SL2T 手語轉文字模型，Pixel 11 首發支援 ASL
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced SL2T, a massively multilingual sign-language-to-text model trained on more than 100,000 hours of data across 50+ sign languages. Starting today it powers American Sign Language-to-English dictation in Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11, allowing Deaf users to sign instead of type. Pose tracking runs on-device for privacy.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出突破性 SL2T 手語轉文字模型，以超過 10 萬小時、跨 50 多種手語資料訓練。今日起在 Pixel 11 的 Gboard 與 Live Transcribe 支援美式手語（ASL）轉英文，讓聽障使用者能直接手語輸入，並採用裝置端姿態追蹤保護隱私。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moves sign-language AI from research demos into everyday consumer devices for the first time. Scalability to more languages and devices will determine real-world impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是手語 AI 首次大規模進入消費產品的重要一步，有望大幅改善無障礙體驗；後續多語言與裝置擴展速度將決定實際影響力。
items_flat.quote: SL2T is our breakthrough sign language-to-text model powering new features for Deaf and hard of hearing users on Android.
items_flat.quote_zh: SL2T 是我們的突破性手語轉文字模型，為 Android 上的聽障使用者提供新功能。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Models Now Available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak 資安模型正式上架 Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made its Daybreak Blue (GPT-5.6 Sol with defensive safeguards) and Daybreak Red (purpose-trained GPT-5.6 Cyber) models available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock. The models support authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation and defensive security workflows inside existing AWS environments.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Daybreak Blue（具備防禦安全護欄的 GPT-5.6 Sol）與 Daybreak Red（專為資安訓練的 GPT-5.6 Cyber）上架 Amazon Bedrock，供合格客戶在既有 AWS 環境中進行授權漏洞研究、利用驗證與防禦安全工作流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extends frontier cyber capabilities into the cloud platforms enterprises already trust, potentially accelerating defender adoption while keeping strict access controls. Real-world zero-day discovery rates will be the measure of impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把前沿資安能力延伸到企業已信任的雲平台，可能加速防禦方採用，同時維持嚴格存取控管；實際零日漏洞發現率將是衡量影響力的關鍵。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing the next step in our work with AWS: making Daybreak capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享與 AWS 合作的下一步：透過 Amazon Bedrock 提供 Daybreak 能力。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Releases Open Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: Efficient 30B MoE for Agentic Workloads
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 開源 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning：高效 30B MoE 代理模型
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (3B active) optimized for high-volume specialized tasks in always-on multi-agent systems. It claims up to 4× faster output speed and is fully open with weights, data and recipes available on Hugging Face and other platforms; it can run on a single consumer GPU.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，30B 參數混合專家模型（3B 活躍參數），專為長時運行代理系統中的高量專業任務優化，宣稱輸出速度可達 4 倍。模型完全開源，權重、資料與配方可於 Hugging Face 等平台取得，並可在單一消費級 GPU 上運行。
items_flat.analysis_en: Reinforces the open-weights efficiency trend for on-device and edge agents. Post-training flexibility and real-world agent harness performance will determine whether it becomes a default execution layer.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 強化開源高效模型在裝置端與邊緣代理的趨勢；後訓練彈性與實際代理框架表現將決定它是否成為預設執行層。
items_flat.quote: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, helps create smarter and more efficient agentic applications.
items_flat.quote_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 是 300 億參數混合專家模型，可協助打造更智慧且更高效的代理應用。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Report: Enterprise AI Shifts from Assistance to Agentic Execution
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 報告：企業 AI 從輔助轉向代理執行
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published data showing enterprise usage is becoming more agentic: Codex accounted for 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers as of June. Frontier firms now generate 8.3× more tokens per user than typical firms, and agentic tools are spreading rapidly into legal, sales and marketing roles.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布數據顯示企業使用正轉向代理化：截至 6 月，Codex 佔企業客戶 Codex 與 ChatGPT 合併輸出 tokens 的 64%。前沿企業每位活躍用戶產出量已達一般企業的 8.3 倍，代理工具正快速擴散至法律、銷售與行銷等職能。
items_flat.analysis_en: Provides rare quantitative evidence of the agent transition inside real companies. The widening frontier-firm gap suggests early movers are compounding advantages that later adopters may struggle to close.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 提供罕見的企業內部代理轉型量化證據。前沿企業與一般企業的差距擴大，顯示早期採用者正在累積後進者難以追上的優勢。
items_flat.quote: Frontier firms—those in the top 10% of AI usage each month—now generate 8.3× as many output tokens per active user as typical firms.
items_flat.quote_zh: 前沿企業（每月 AI 使用量前 10%）現在每位活躍用戶產出的 tokens 已達一般企業的 8.3 倍。
